subject: Do you need to have STAN installed to use RStan? (Windows)

messages.author: 0e85f6c4190fd9ac
messages.subject: Do you need to have STAN installed to use RStan? (Windows)
parts:
I have installed Rstan (plus the prerequisites) and was able to run the "school code" example without having STAN installed. I am questioning if I need to have STAN installed at all. I could not find anything on the site.

Thanks!

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Do you need to have STAN installed to use RStan? (Windows)
parts:
RStan includes Stan, so you don't need to install Stan
separately. I just added a note to this effect in the
pre-requisites section of the install instructions.

I think it's confusing confusing because we list Stan
and RStan separately on the home page and because the R
interfaces to BUGS and JAGS required those packages to be
installed separately. (The downside of how we do it is that the
entire package with Stan included is too large for CRAN.)

- Bob
